name: waystation-terminal-bridge
description: Send Waystation messages to Claude Code in its original local VS Code terminal.

waystation.terminalBridge.enabled.description: Allow the authenticated local Waystation daemon to submit messages to idle Claude Code sessions in this window's terminals. Keep their input empty when sending from Waystation.

waystation.terminalBridge.dataDirectory.description: Waystation data directory. Empty uses AGENT_TOWER_HOME or the default local application data folder.
